title.narrative: Increased capacity of the constituents to facilitate the access of enterprises to business development and financial services, enhancing their sustainability and competitiveness for decent work

description.narrative: The following are the major global deliverables and activities of the ILO in this policy area. (1) scaled up analysis of market systems from a productivity and employment perspective, with due regard to the strategic objectives of the Decent Work Agenda and to gender equality and non-discrimination. (2) Capacity development of ILO constituents to stimulate productivity growth, green enterprise development and innovation through global training programmes, peer reviews and mutual learning and support (3) Facilitation of access to existing platforms to promote inclusive enterprise development, women economic empowerment, green entrepreneurship creation and decent work in the green economy. (4) Development and implementation of simple digital tools aimed at MSMEs and SSE entities, targeting management and OSH practices, productivity growth, collective bargaining, workplace cooperation and improved working conditions.
